user.title: Kodi Link
user.description: Which entities Kodi can see and operate. Leave a label blank to create it with its default name («Kodi: ve» or «Kodi: actúa»). Then add each Kodi from the integration itself.

data_description.etiqueta_ve: Entities with this label are shown, read only, on every Kodi with level «Sees» or «Operates».
data_description.etiqueta_actua: Entities with this label are shown too, and Kodi devices with level «Operates» will be able to operate them.

error.etiquetas_iguales: The two labels must be different.

data_description.etiqueta_ve: Entities with this label are shown, read only, on every Kodi with level «Sees» or «Operates».
data_description.etiqueta_actua: Entities with this label are shown too, and Kodi devices with level «Operates» will be able to operate them.

error.etiquetas_iguales: The two labels must be different.

data_description.kodi: A player of the Kodi integration. The service.ha_link add-on must be installed on that Kodi.
data_description.nivel: Nothing: receives nothing. Sees: shows the labelled entities. Operates: can also operate the «Kodi: actúa» ones.
data_description.vista: What opens from Programs → HA Link: board by area (A), rows by room (C) or the plain list.
data_description.tecla: Remote key that shows the side panel (B) over the video. «None» disables it.
